scope: All authenticated testing uses production Next/BFF with isolated in-memory HTTP upstreams. User explicitly prohibited synthetic writes to habitual databases.

ST.ST-01: academic-state unit: draft retained between tools
ST.ST-02: academic-state unit: source-specific drafts and review invalidation
ST.ST-03: unit + browser: Quiz node, answers and question retained while appearance changes
ST.ST-04: unit + browser: Crossword cell node and letters retained while appearance changes
ST.ST-05: unit + browser: expansion, theme and background retain draft and activity state
ST.ST-06: controller unit + activities integration: lost-response exact frozen envelope; no real Spring writes
ST.ST-07: controller unit + activities integration: synchronous lock and late original response; no real Spring writes
ST.ST-08: browser: leaving to Appearance opens existing guard; cancellation retains draft
ST.ST-09: AES/recovery unit + browser: real encrypted IndexedDB copy and purge
ST.ST-10: controller destruction unit + browser: bottom-account logout and success/denied recovery purge

limits: No authenticated Spring end-to-end run because user selected memory-only tests
Firefox/WebKit, screen reader and physical device performance pending
